claims.text: The product can reset, recover and repair a WordPress site in no time

quote.text: Reset, recover, and repair your WordPress site in no time

claims.text: A bad plugin or tweak can leave a site broken requiring hours to fix by hand

quote.text: One bad plugin or experimental tweak can leave your WordPress site broken, and fixing it by hand takes hours.

claims.text: Reset, delete, or restore sections of a site, even after a hack

quote.text: WP Reset lets you reset, delete, or restore sections of your site, even after a hack.

claims.text: Restore everything to default values without reinstalling WordPress or doing it manually

quote.text: WP Reset lets you restore everything to default values without reinstalling WordPress or doing it all manually.

claims.text: Reset or delete select portions of a site to debug or streamline, including unused widgets

quote.text: You can even reset or delete select portions of your site to debug or streamline in record time, including removing all those unused widgets slowing you down.

claims.text: Completely rebrand the plugin including logo, colors and name without code

quote.text: You’ll also be able to completely rebrand the plugin and impress your clients—logo, colors, name, and all—without touching a line of code.

claims.text: Take a Snapshot to store a copy of the current version to return to

quote.text: Take a Snapshot of the site to store a copy of the current version to easily return to if need be.

claims.text: Snapshots are stored in WP Reset Cloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or pCloud

quote.text: These Snapshots are stored in WP Reset Cloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or pCloud, so you’ll always have a copy waiting for you.

claims.text: Use the Emergency Recovery Script to reclaim a website without admin access

quote.text: Even if you can’t access your site admin, you can use WP Reset’s Emergency Recovery Script to reclaim your website.

claims.text: Emergency Recovery Script comes with over 12 tools including Snapshot support

quote.text: This powerful feature comes with over 12 tools, including support for Snapshots to get your site out of any sticky situation.

trials.claim: Tier 3 includes unlimited site licenses and 30 WPR cloud site licenses
trials.claimQuote:
- Unlimited Site licenses
- 30 WPR cloud site licenses
- 3 GB Storage per cloud site license
- Remote actions and remote stats
trials.reasoning: The exhibits discuss the 3GB storage cap and misleading unlimited-storage marketing, but none confirm or contradict the stated unlimited site licenses or 30 cloud site licenses.

exhibits.quote: My main issue is with their “Unlimited Cloud Storage” upsell — which is highly misleading and probably illegal.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the unlimited cloud marketing for the tier is misleading rather than true unlimited storage.

exhibits.quote: One of my WooCommerce site’s snapshots was over 3.5GB, meaning even without buying the upgrade, I could already see it wouldn’t be usable.
exhibits.argument: Buyer shows the 3GB per-site cap makes the included cloud site licenses unusable for larger sites.

trials.claim: Tier 2 includes 50 site licenses and 15 WPR cloud site licenses with 3 GB storage
trials.claimQuote:
- 50 Site licenses
- 15 WPR cloud site licenses
- 3 GB Storage per cloud site license
- Remote actions and remote stats
trials.reasoning: A buyer reported an error that the maximum of 1 active site had been reached, directly conflicting with Tier 2 including 50 site licenses.

exhibits.quote: Error: Unable to activate site. Maximum allowed number of active sites (1) has been reached.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not activate a second site despite a multi-site limit, undermining the site-license quantity claim.

exhibits.quote: what they’re actually selling is unlimited site licenses, each with a hard 3GB per-site cap.
exhibits.argument: Buyer states the cloud offer is capped at 3GB per site, limiting the advertised storage benefit.

trials.claim: The product can reset, recover and repair a WordPress site in no time
trials.claimQuote: Reset, recover, and repair your WordPress site in no time
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm recovering sites in seconds and restoring a snapshot almost instantly, outweighing the single reported restore failure.

exhibits.quote: As soon as I activated the pro version on my site I got the
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports activation immediately broke the site instead of enabling quick recovery and repair.

exhibits.quote: I never could get the site restored properly using just this plugin alone.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the plugin failed to restore the site, contradicting fast recover and repair.

exhibits.quote: You will recover your sites thanks to the snapshots in seconds.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the product recovers sites in seconds via snapshots.

exhibits.quote: All I had to do was click "Restore Snapshot" from the morning and blink, it was done.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms one-click snapshot restore repairs the site almost instantly.

trials.claim: Reset, delete, or restore sections of a site, even after a hack
trials.claimQuote: WP Reset lets you reset, delete, or restore sections of your site, even after a hack.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report cloud-snapshot restores and snapshot creation failing, while the defense exhibits only confirm resetting after testing, not restoring sections after a hack.

exhibits.quote: Restoring from cloud snapshot also gave me an error.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports restore from snapshot failed, undermining restore-after-damage claim.

exhibits.quote: when I want to create a user snapshot there is an error while backing up a regular table of wordfence plugin.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports snapshot creation fails on a common plugin table, undermining reset-restore reliability.

exhibits.quote: I was new to WordPress and needed to reset after some testing.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms using the product to reset a site after testing.

exhibits.quote: I mainly needed this to reset sites after testing and it does and amazingly good job.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the reset function works amazingly well for test sites.

trials.claim: Restore everything to default values without reinstalling WordPress or doing it manually
trials.claimQuote: WP Reset lets you restore everything to default values without reinstalling WordPress or doing it all manually.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the full-reset option failed and a wipe left images in upload folders, contradicting restoring everything to default values.

exhibits.quote: First thing I tried was the 'nuclear option' and it failed miserably.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the full-reset option failed, contradicting restore-to-default without reinstalling.

exhibits.quote: Then, I did the non-nuclear wipe and it left all of the images in the upload folders.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the wipe left files behind, so it did not restore everything to default values.

exhibits.quote: Instead of spending hours trying to fix what Elementor broke, I can write this review.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms restore avoided hours of manual fixing after breakage.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't delete all files from WordPress, thus I couldn't install themes properly.
exhibits.argument: This buyer shows the product solved a reset problem they could not fix manually.

trials.claim: A bad plugin or tweak can leave a site broken requiring hours to fix by hand
trials.claimQuote: One bad plugin or experimental tweak can leave your WordPress site broken, and fixing it by hand takes hours.
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm a plugin update can break a site and that fixing Elementor breakage by hand would have taken hours.

exhibits.quote: the worst is one day your site may break due to plugin update.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms a plugin update can break a WordPress site.

exhibits.quote: Instead of spending hours trying to fix what Elementor broke, I can write this review.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms fixing a broken site by hand would take hours.

it eats your sql data , full of bugs.
In combination with WP time capsule I get a 64gb installation who should be 200 mb.

Restoring from cloud snapshot also gave me an error.

themes.summary: Many buyers say snapshots and restore reliably saved them after updates or broken sites.

It is quite easy and straightforward.
restored my site to 15 minutes before the crash.

The auto snapshot is very helpful, can revert back like a breeze!
I'm impressed with how fast it is and how stupid easy it is to use.
so far it is ticking away as the tool you need.

the support team answered each and every one of them quickly.
